## Agent tokens

`Estimate tokens` requires both lines. `era-issue` is the roadmap issue this pull request implements, or `0` when it does not. `era-tokens` is the whole number of tokens the agent consumed, or `0` when no agent ran. On merge, a positive count is stored for this pull request and, when `era-issue` is positive, for that issue.
